'''A'den'''<ref name="Guide" /> (pronounced AH-den<ref name="RC:TripleZero">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]'' {{C|Rear Mando'a Dictionary}}</ref>), designated '''CT-80/88-3009''', was a [[senior clone commander]] in command of the [[7th Legion]], a division of the [[327th Star Corps/Legends|327th Star Corps]].<ref name="Guide" /> "A'den" was a word in the [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']] [[Language/Legends|language]] that meant "rage" or "wrath."<ref name="RC:TripleZero" /> As a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]], A'den was created on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] from the [[Clone template/Legends|clone template]] of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. The [[Gender|male]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] shared the template's [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin and height of 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="Clone Databank" />

==Behind the scenes==
A'den was first mentioned in the "[[Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic]]," an reference article in the [[Star Wars Insider 84|eighty-fourth issue]] of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'',<ref name="Guide" /> released on [[September 26]], [[2005]].<ref name="SW">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20050913.html|text=The Ultimate Clone Guide in ''Star Wars Insider'' #84}}</ref> Named by author [[Karen Traviss]], it was the same name given to [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando|''Null''-class Advanced Recon Commando]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[A'den Skirata|N-12]]. This is to set up how coincidental names are chosen by [[Clone trooper/Legends|troopers]] in the Grand Army, such as troopers with the last digit in their [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] being five, the trooper may take the name "Fi".
